info.text:
# Stick Ranger

Welcome to Stick Ranger in Archipelago! Form your team of rangers, level up, and unlock new stages and classes as you journey through a randomized adventure!

## Where is the options page?

The [player options page for Stick Ranger](../player-options) contains all the configuration options you need to customize your experience and export a config file.

## What does randomization do to this game?

A Stage would normally be unlocked by completing the previous Stage, but Stage unlocks are now moved around. There is some logic available to make sure you do not end up with needing to complete late-game stages as your first in-logic check, so the game should always be completable.

If enabled, acquiring a book for a stage for the first time sends a check, enemies have a chance to drop an item that sends a check, and buying each item in a shop for the first time sends a check. Ranger classes can also be shuffled into the item pool, making you start with only 1 class. Classes can be changed at the Forget Tree, which is also unlocked when you have class randomiser on.

With Progressive Shop on, each town's shop opens a row at a time as you receive that town's Progressive Shop items, instead of as you beat stages.

## How do I know which stage I am supposed to do next?

The dots on the world map are colour coded:

- **White** — a town (Town, Village, Resort, Forget Tree, Island).
- **Yellow** — unlocked and in logic. Archipelago expects you to be able to do this one.
- **Orange** — unlocked, but out of logic. You can walk in and try anyway; the generator did not count on it.
- **Dark red** — every check in this stage has been sent.
- **Grey** — out of logic and barred, when Enforce Logic is on.

The five boss stages (Castle, Submarine Shrine, Pyramid, Ice Castle, Hell Castle) also want a number of
stage unlocks from the region in front of them, and a number of ranger classes. Both numbers come from
your YAML, and the class count includes the class you started with. Mountaintop asks for the same as Ice Castle.

## Which items can be in another player's world?

Stage unlocks, class unlocks and Progressive Shop items (if enabled) may be placed into another player's world. Filler items can be traps (if enabled) or any weapon or compo.

## What does another world’s item look like in Stick Ranger?

Enemies that drop a check drop a small AP logo. Stage exits and books do not have anything different than normal. In a shop, a check shows the Archipelago logo until it is bought, or the item it holds when Shop Hints is on; a check holding progression or a trap wears a marked logo.

## What is considered a location check in Stick Ranger?

- **Stage Exits:** Beating a stage for the first time sends a check.
- **Books:** Acquiring a book for a stage sends a check.
- **Enemy Defeats:** Enemies have a chance to drop a check item, depending on settings.
- **Shop Purchases:** Buying each item in a shop for the first time sends a check, when Shop Checks is on.

## When the player receives an item, what happens?

Stage unlocks and class unlocks are applied immediately, and a Progressive Shop item opens the next row of its town's shop.
Traps are only activated if you are in a playable state (so inside any stage, also shop stages).
Weapons and compos are given to you when you have space in your inventory.

## What is the goal of Stick Ranger when randomized?

Clear the boss stage chosen in your YAML options: Castle, Submarine Shrine, Pyramid, Ice Castle, Mountaintop, Hell Castle or Volcano, or a mix of the last three.
An earlier goal makes for a shorter run: everything past it is cut from the seed, and opens for free play once you have goaled.

tutorials.text:
# Stick Ranger Randomizer Setup Guide

Stick Ranger is played on its official page at [dan-ball.jp](https://dan-ball.jp/en/javagame/ranger/). The
Archipelago client is a userscript: the game keeps loading from Dan-Ball, and the script adds the client on top of it.
Stick Ranger is made by ha55ii; nothing of the game is part of the script.

## Required Software

- A desktop browser: Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari or Opera.
- The [Tampermonkey](https://www.tampermonkey.net/) browser extension.
- `stick-ranger-archipelago.user.js`, the client, from the
  [latest release](https://github.com/Kryen112/AP_Stick_Ranger/releases/latest).
- To generate a multiworld yourself: `stick_ranger.apworld` from the same release, placed in the `custom_worlds`
  folder of your Archipelago installation.

## Installing the client

1. Install Tampermonkey from your browser's extension store.
2. In Chrome or Edge, open the extensions page (`chrome://extensions` or `edge://extensions`), choose **Details** on
   Tampermonkey and turn on **Allow User Scripts**. Without it the browser doesn't let Tampermonkey run any script.
   Older versions have no such switch; turn on **Developer mode** on the extensions page instead.
3. Open
   [stick-ranger-archipelago.user.js](https://github.com/Kryen112/AP_Stick_Ranger/releases/latest/download/stick-ranger-archipelago.user.js).
   Tampermonkey shows an install page; choose **Install**.
4. Go to [Stick Ranger](https://dan-ball.jp/en/javagame/ranger/). An **Archipelago** window appears over the page.
   Drag it by its title bar; the **–** button folds it away.

Tampermonkey checks for updates of the script by itself. Each new release of the apworld comes with a matching client,
so after an update of the apworld, make sure the script is up to date too: in Tampermonkey's menu, choose **Check for
userscript updates**.

## Configuring your YAML file

### What is a YAML file and why do I need one?

Your YAML file contains a set of configuration options which provide the generator with information about how it
should generate your game. Each player of a multiworld will provide their own YAML file. This setup allows each player
to enjoy an experience customized for their taste, and different players in the same multiworld can all have different
options.

### Where do I get a YAML file?

You can customize your settings by visiting the
[Stick Ranger Player Options Page](/games/Stick%20Ranger/player-options).

That page is only available on a host that has the Stick Ranger apworld installed. Otherwise, take the
`Stick Ranger.yaml` template attached to the
[latest release](https://github.com/Kryen112/AP_Stick_Ranger/releases/latest) and edit it by hand, or generate a fresh
one from your own Archipelago install with **Generate Template Options** in the Launcher.

Put the finished yaml in Archipelago's `Players` folder before you generate.

## Joining a multiworld game

1. Go to [Stick Ranger](https://dan-ball.jp/en/javagame/ranger/).
2. In the Archipelago window, enter the **server**, **port**, **slot name** and **password** (if the room has one),
   and choose **Connect**.
3. The page reloads once, into AP mode: its address now ends in `#ap…`.
4. If this slot has a saved run, choose **Load Game** on the title screen. If not, choose **New Game** and pick your
   team.

With Archipelago installed, there is a shortcut: on the room page, click your slot name. The Archipelago Launcher opens
the game page with the server, port and slot already filled in. **Stick Ranger Client** in the Launcher opens the game
page too.

Type in the bottom of the window to chat with the room. `!hint stage` and `!hint class` ask Archipelago for whatever
the next locked boss gate still needs.

## Your saves

- Your Archipelago run is saved on the Archipelago server, with your slot, and loads wherever you connect to it.
- Your normal Stick Ranger save is never touched. In AP mode the game neither reads nor writes it. Choose
  **Disconnect** to leave AP mode: the page reloads with your normal save.
- To start a run over on the same slot, choose **New Game**. Everything you received comes back at once, except traps:
  each trap hits a slot only once.
- Rankings are off in AP mode, so multiworld runs never reach Dan-Ball's leaderboards.

## Troubleshooting

- **No Archipelago window:** check that Tampermonkey is allowed to run scripts (step 2 of the install), and that the
  script is switched on in Tampermonkey's menu while you are on the game page.
- **Playing on a server on your own computer** (`localhost`): Chrome asks whether dan-ball.jp may connect to your local
  network. Allow it, or the client cannot reach the server.
- **"Stick Ranger has been updated on dan-ball.jp":** the script only runs on the version of the game it was made
  for. When Dan-Ball updates the game, the client stays off until a matching update of the script is out.
- **The seed was made with a newer apworld than the client:** update the script, as described under
  [Installing the client](#installing-the-client).

readme.text:
# Stick Ranger integration for Archipelago

## Table of Contents

1. [Installation](#installation)
2. [AP Integration](#ap-integration)
    - [Goal](#goal)
    - [Locations](#locations)
    - [Items](#items)
    - [Progression](#progression)
    - [Options](#options)
3. [Saving & Persistence](#saving--persistence)
4. [Building the apworld](#building-the-apworld)
5. [Tests](#tests)
6. [Contributing](#contributing)
7. [License](#license)
8. [Contact & Support](#contact--support)
9. [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements)

---

## Installation

-   Download the APworld for Stick Ranger
-   Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a yaml or download the one in here
-   Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a game
-   Install [Tampermonkey](https://www.tampermonkey.net/) and the client, `stick-ranger-archipelago.user.js` from the
    release, then play on [the official Stick Ranger page](https://dan-ball.jp/en/javagame/ranger/); the
    [setup guide](stick_ranger/docs/setup_en.md) has the details

## AP Integration

### Goal

Clear the boss stage your yaml picks: Castle, Submarine Shrine, Pyramid, Ice
Castle, Mountaintop, Hell Castle (the default) or Volcano, or a mix of the last
three.

Everything past your goal is cut from the seed: those stages, their books,
enemies and shop rows hold no checks, and their unlocks are never handed out.
Boss stages beside your goal that it does not need stay playable, but only ever
hold filler. Once you goal, every stage past it opens for free play.

### Locations

Checks are send when:

-   You complete a stage
-   You buy a book (when shuffle_books is on)
-   When an AP item from an enemy is dropped and picked up (when shuffle_enemies is on)
-   You buy an item in a shop for the first time (when shop_checks is on)

### Items

You can receive:

-   Stage unlocks
-   Class unlocks (if ranger_class_randomizer is enabled)
-   Progressive Shop items, one track per town (if progressive_shop is enabled)
-   A random item (any weapon/compo)
-   Traps (if enabled)

### Progression

Five boss stages gate the game, each waiting on the one before it:

    Castle -> Submarine Shrine -> Pyramid -> Ice Castle -> Hell Castle
                                         `-> Mountaintop

A boss opens once you hold its own stage unlock, enough stage unlocks from the
region in front of it, and enough ranger classes (your starting class counts).
The stages counted per boss are:

| Boss             | Counts             | Out of |
| ---------------- | ------------------ | ------ |
| Castle           | pre-Castle stages  | 17     |
| Submarine Shrine | sea stages         | 12     |
| Pyramid          | desert stages      | 12     |
| Ice Castle       | ice stages         | 15     |
| Hell Castle      | hell stages        | 21     |

Mountaintop sits in the snow, so it branches off Pyramid and asks for what Ice
Castle asks, bar Ice Castle's own unlock. Volcano is a boss rush stage sitting
behind the Hell Castle gate.

The world map colours each stage dot by the same rules: yellow is in logic,
orange is unlocked but out of logic, dark red means every check there has been
sent, and white is a town. The apworld ships its rules to the client in
slot_data as a logic description, and the client evaluates that rather than
carrying rules of its own, so the map and the generator cannot disagree.

### Options

Every option is documented where you set it: in the `Stick Ranger.yaml`
template attached to each release, and on the player options page of any host
with the apworld installed. **Generate Template Options** in the Archipelago
Launcher writes a fresh template for the apworld you have installed.

## Saving & Persistence

-   **Save state is on Archipelago's DataStorage**
-   **Key structure**:
    ```
    Stick Ranger:[slotName]:[seed]
    ```
-   Auto-save triggers:
    -   Receiving items
    -   Sending checks
    -   Scouting Book and shop locations (opening the shop)
    -   Leaving a stage or a town

## Building the apworld

Packaging goes through Archipelago's own `Build APWorlds` Launcher component,
which is what writes the `archipelago.json` manifest (required from AP 0.7.0),
drops `__pycache__` and guarantees portable path separators in the archive.

Once, to let Archipelago see the world:

```sh
py -3.12 build_apworld.py --link
```

That links `<Archipelago>/worlds/stick_ranger` at this repo. Point `AP_ROOT` at
your Archipelago source checkout if it is not a sibling of this folder. Then:

```sh
py -3.12 build_apworld.py
```

builds, verifies and installs `stick_ranger.apworld` into `custom_worlds`. Add
`--no-install` to build without copying it anywhere.

## Tests

```sh
py -3.12 scripts/run_world_tests.py
```

runs the world's tests inside the linked Archipelago checkout. CI runs the same
suite plus Archipelago's general world tests on every push.

## Contributing

Feel free to contribute or mod.

## License

This project is licensed under the **[MIT License](LICENSE)**. Feel free to use, modify, and distribute.

## Contact & Support

Please contact inside the Archipelago Discord, inside the Stick Ranger post inside future-game-design, or contact Kryen112 on Discord directly.

## Acknowledgements

-   Please support ha55ii, the original creator of Stick Ranger, by playing his games on [dan-ball](http://dan-ball.jp), including the original Stick Ranger and other web games.
-   Thanks to Dire Storm from the Dan-Ball Discord for making a Vanilla Translation Mod.

---

notes.text:
## Installation

-   Download the APworld for Stick Ranger
-   Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a yaml or download the one in here
-   Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a game
-   Install [Tampermonkey](https://www.tampermonkey.net/) and the client, `stick-ranger-archipelago.user.js` from this
    release, then play on [the official Stick Ranger page](https://dan-ball.jp/en/javagame/ranger/); the
    [setup guide](https://github.com/Kryen112/AP_Stick_Ranger/blob/main/stick_ranger/docs/setup_en.md) has the details

## Heads up

-   **Stick Ranger is now played on its official page at dan-ball.jp.** The client is a Tampermonkey userscript,
    attached to this release. The old website client is gone.
-   **Early goals are in.** You can now finish on Castle, Submarine Shrine, Pyramid or Ice Castle; see below.
-   **Your 1.8 yaml still generates.** The new options take their defaults, and a yaml asking for 22 Hell stages
    reads as the new maximum of 21. Regenerate the template to see the new options.
-   **Seeds from apworld 1.8.12 and 1.8.13 play in the new client.** Seeds from before 1.8.12 are not supported.
-   Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.

## The userscript client

-   Install [stick-ranger-archipelago.user.js](https://github.com/Kryen112/AP_Stick_Ranger/releases/latest/download/stick-ranger-archipelago.user.js)
    with Tampermonkey. In Chrome and Edge, turn on **Allow User Scripts** for Tampermonkey first. Tampermonkey keeps
    the script up to date from the latest release.
-   The game loads from dan-ball.jp as always; the script adds an Archipelago window on top of it. Stick Ranger is
    made by ha55ii, and nothing of the game is part of this project.
-   Everything the old client did is there: stage, class and shop checks, book and shop hints, traps, DeathLink,
    Ring Link, the multipliers, the map colours, Forget Tree class swaps, free revival with the whole party down,
    removable compos, and the AP logo ranger symbol.

## Early goals

-   **New goals: Castle, Submarine Shrine, Pyramid and Ice Castle**, next to Mountaintop, Hell Castle, Volcano and
    the combined goals.
-   **Everything past your goal is cut**: those stages, their books, enemies and shop rows hold no checks, and their
    unlocks are never handed out. Boss stages beside your goal that it does not need stay playable but only hold
    filler. Once you goal, every stage past it opens for free play and every shop is fully stocked.
-   **Mountaintop is gated like Ice Castle** instead of behind Hell Castle, since it sits in the snow, and the
    Unlock !!! stage now counts towards Ice instead of Hell.
-   **New options**: `towns_in_pool` (which towns can be unlocked), `surplus_classes` (what happens to the classes
    your goal does not need), `cap_loot_at_goal` (filler weapons and compos no stronger than your goal's area) and
    `scale_loot_with_progress` (filler that grows stronger as your run opens up).
-   The client's `!hint stage` and `!hint class` follow your goal, so a Mountaintop goal never asks for Ice Castle.

## AP mode and your normal save

-   Connecting reloads the page into AP mode (the address ends in `#ap`). In AP mode the game neither reads nor
    writes your normal Stick Ranger save; **Disconnect** brings it back.
-   Rankings are off in AP mode, so multiworld runs never reach Dan-Ball's leaderboards.

## Launcher

-   **Stick Ranger Client** is back in the Launcher. It opens the game page; from a room page, clicking your slot
    name opens it with the server, port and slot filled in.

## Fixes

-   **New Game** gives back every item received so far at once, without reconnecting.
-   **Traps** hit a slot only once: starting a New Game or reconnecting never fires them again.
-   **Full Screen** shows only the game and the Archipelago window.
